arguments.value: Gray Hampton Miller is a United States District Judge for the Southern District of Texas, having been nominated by President George W. Bush in 2006 and confirmed by the Senate that same year. Born in Houston, Texas in 1948, he earned his B.A. from the University of Houston in 1974 and his J.D. from the University of Houston Law Center in 1978. He practiced law in Houston in private practice from 1978 until his judicial appointment and assumed senior status in December 2018.
